items.name: Chääswürfel 2024
items.information: [DE] Nach dem Turnier veranstalten wir ein gemeinsames Raclette-Essen. Wir würden uns freuen, wenn auch du dabei bist und zusammen mit uns ins neue Jahr "cubest". Im **Tab "Raclette" f**indest du alle wichtigen Informationen. Bitte beachte, dass der **Anmeldeschluss für das Raclette-Essen vor Anmeldeschluss der Competition liegt**. [EN] After the competition, we will have a raclette dinner together. We would be delighted if you could join us and "cube" into the new year. You can find all the important information in the **"Raclette" tab**. Please note that the **registration deadline for the raclette dinner is before the competition registration deadline**.

As we get closer to the competition, you will be informed about where we are ordering from and how you can pay.

items.name: New New York New Year 2024
items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab. Please note the schedule of this competition - there are events/rounds taking place from **9pm** on New Year's Eve (December 31, 2024) to **2am** on New Year's Day (January 1, 2025), and then 9:30am to 1:30pm on New Year's Day.
